observations.ledger_digest_note: TransitionLog event_digest is SemanticJira.digest/1 over the event, which drops the top-level receipt_digest and definition_digest fields: two events differing only there are one event (:already_recorded), and editing an event's receipt_digest in the ledger file is not detected as tampering. Bootstrap's receipt binding bounds the effect (a rewritten receipt_digest must still name a current linked receipt of the same order with the same standing). Kernel file lib/ggen_igniter/semantic_jira/transition_log.ex is outside this lane; successor candidate below.
